---
title: 01. 단순회귀모형
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

## 02. 단순회귀모형

```{r}
market <- read.csv("./data/ch01/market-1.csv")
head(market)

market_lm <- lm(Y ~ X, data = market)
summary(market_lm)
names(market_lm)

market_lm$resid
```

## 03. 단순회귀모형

> 잔차들의 합은 0이다.

```{r}
sum(market_lm$resid)
```

> 관찰값 $Y_i$의 합과 추정값 $\hat{Y_i}$의 합은 같다

```{r}
sum(market_lm$fitted)
sum(market$Y)
```

> 잔차들의 $X_i$에 대한 가중합은 0이다.

```{r}
sum(market$X * market_lm$resid)
```

> 잔차들의 $\hat{Y_i}$에 의한 가중합은 0이다.

```{r}
sum(market_lm$fitted * market_lm$resid)
```

## 04. 단순회귀 분산분석표

```{r}
res_anova <- anova(market_lm)
res_anova
names(res_anova)
ss <- res_anova$`Sum Sq`
ssr <- ss[1]
sse <- ss[2]
sst <- ssr + sse
ssr / sst
```

```{r}
par(family = "AppleGothic")

plot(market$X, market$Y, xlab = "인테리어비", ylab = "총판매액", pch = 19)
title("인테리어비와 판매액의 산점도")

abline(market_lm)

xbar <- mean(market$X)
ybar <- mean(market$Y)
c(xbar, ybar)
points(xbar, ybar, pch = 17, cex = 2.0, col = "RED")
text(xbar + 1, ybar - 1, "(8.85, 19.36)")

fx <- "Y-hat = 0.33 + 2.15 * X"
text(xbar - 2, ybar + 3, fx)
```

## 07. 분석사례

```{r}
super <- read.csv("./data/ch01/supermarket.csv")
head(super, 3)

super_lm <- lm(time ~ price, data = super)
summary(super_lm)

anova(super_lm)

names(super_lm)
cbind(super, super_lm$resid, super_lm$fitted)

plot(super$price, super$time, pch = 19)
abline(super_lm)

plot(super$price, super_lm$resid, pch = 19)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

super_predict <- predict(super_lm, interval = "predict")
super_data <- cbind(super, super_predict)

ggplot(super_data, aes(x = price, y = time)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(method = lm) +
  geom_line(aes(y = lwr), col = "coral2", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = upr), col = "coral2", linetype = "dashed")
```
